request.text: Check the weather at Lincoln Middle School for 4:00 p.m. tomorrow; if rain is forecast, set a 3:30 p.m. reminder to pack the poster tube for science-fair setup, and if not, just tell me the forecast.

responsibilities.outcome: Check tomorrow's 4:00 p.m. weather at Lincoln Middle School and, only if rain is forecast, create a 3:30 p.m. reminder to pack the science-fair poster tube; otherwise report the forecast without creating the reminder.

new_goals.description: Check tomorrow's 4:00 p.m. weather at Lincoln Middle School and conditionally create a 3:30 p.m. poster-tube reminder when rain is forecast.
new_goals.source_text: Check the weather at Lincoln Middle School for 4:00 p.m. tomorrow; if rain is forecast, set a 3:30 p.m. reminder to pack the poster tube for science-fair setup, and if not, just tell me the forecast.
constraints: Check the specified weather before choosing the conditional branch.
Create the 3:30 p.m. reminder only when the forecast indicates rain.
If rain is not forecast, report the forecast without creating the reminder.
success_criteria: The user receives the requested forecast.
A 3:30 p.m. poster-tube reminder is created if and only if rain is forecast.

semantic_facts: Restored availability replans only this open Goal into a weather lookup followed by a reminder activity conditional on a rain result.
Availability is not forecast Evidence: the weather result must precede branch selection, and the reminder runs only for rain.
forbidden_claims: Rain is forecast or the poster-tube reminder is set merely because providers are available.
The reminder is unconditional, precedes the lookup, or another Goal is replanned.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Restored availability substitutes for data needed to select a conditional branch.
Scoped re-entry loses dependency ordering or emits premature completion.
